## SEO autopilot (Sprint AI Lab)
Weekly: audit both pages, score them, compare with last run, ask AI for prioritised fixes, email the team and open a GitHub issue for the fixes.

**Before activating:** fill the REPLACE_ values in the Config node and the error email node, then attach the three credentials (SMTP, Anthropic header key, GitHub). Changes are proposed as issues for a human to approve, never auto-published.
